title: Hiccup and his dragon Toothless.
lines: On a cold island there's a Viking village.
The Vikings have big beards and helmets with horns.
There's a big problem.
Every night dragons come.
They steal the sheep and the fish.
The Vikings fight the dragons.
They think all dragons are dangerous.
A boy lives in the village.
His name is Hiccup.
He is small and thin.
He isn't strong like the other Vikings.
But Hiccup is clever.
He makes inventions.
His dad is the chief.
Dad wants Hiccup to catch a dragon.
One night Hiccup shoots a net into the sky with one of his inventions.
He hits a dragon!
The next day he goes looking in the forest.
There lies the dragon.
A black dragon with big green eyes.
It's a Night Fury, the rarest dragon of all.
The dragon is stuck in the net.
He looks at Hiccup.
He's scared.
At first Hiccup wants to hurt him.
But then he sees the scared eyes.
And he cuts the rope.
The dragon flies away.
But he can't get far.
A piece of his tail is broken.
Without that piece he can't fly properly.
Every day Hiccup goes to see the dragon.
He brings fish.
The dragon has no teeth when he smiles.
They pull back into his mouth.
Hiccup calls him Toothless.
Hiccup makes a new piece of tail for Toothless.
Out of leather and wood.
And a saddle, so he can sit on him.
Together they learn to fly.
At first they often fall into the water.
Splash!
But then they get it.
They fly through the clouds.
Hiccup cheers.
Hiccup learns a lot about dragons.
They love fish.
They like it when you tickle them under the chin.
And they're scared of eels.
Dragons aren't mean, says Hiccup.
They're just scared of us.
Just like we're scared of them.
At first Dad doesn't believe him.
But then a gigantic angry dragon comes.
All the Vikings are in danger.
Hiccup and Toothless fly together.
They're faster than the big dragon.
They save the whole village.
Dad hugs Hiccup.
I'm proud of you, son.
From then on the Vikings and the dragons live together.
Every Viking has their own dragon.
And Hiccup has the very best friend in the world.
The end.
